description: Creates a report definition with a chosen set of widgets, in print order. Returns `{ id }`. FREE: database only, no SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

widgetTypes.description: Widget types, in print order. Catalogue: site_health (Crawl findings and issue counts from the latest audit.); internal_linking (Orphan pages, dead ends and link depth from the latest crawl.); rank_tracking (Rank-tracker scorecards per tracked domain.); keywords (Saved keywords with volume, difficulty and CPC.); search_console (Search Console totals and top queries/pages.); web_analytics (Sessions, pageviews and bounce rate from the tracking snippet.); gsc_coverage (How many of your pages Search Console has inspected, and their most common state.); rank_movers (Keywords that newly started ranking or climbed fast.); rank_volatility (How much your own positions churned between the last two checks.); share_of_voice (Your tracked domain's share of visibility against its competitors.); log_analyzer (Total server hits and the AI-crawler share of them.)

name: create_report_definition
